snapshot_source: Live tool list and full JSON schemas loaded through ToolSearch in a Claude Code desktop session on 2026-11-13. 31 tools, 11 of them added since the 2026-09-02 snapshot.

tools.name: budget-rollup
tools.description: One budget book's figures summed by department, category, fund, or division, largest first, with a grand total. Requires organizationId, meetingDocumentId, and by. Expenditures by default; lineType switches to revenue or all.

tools.name: get-bill
tools.description: One bill: number, title, description, status, chambers (originating body, pending committee), type, subjects, and sponsors. cloverleaf_url can be null when the bill has no viewable page.

tools.name: get-bill-documents
tools.description: A bill's texts, amendments, and supplements. Each carries a cloverleaf_url and a meeting_document_id readable through get-document.

tools.name: get-bill-events
tools.description: Scheduled legislative calendar events for a bill, such as committee hearings and floor votes.

tools.name: get-bill-status-changes
tools.description: Merged status timeline for a bill: official status changes plus amendment, supplement, and calendar activity. Filter event_kind == "history" for official status changes.

tools.name: get-budget-line-item
tools.description: One budget line item in full: every printed cell (each year and column, the primary one flagged), its book, department, fund, and category, and up to 20 neighbouring detail lines. Requires organizationId and lineItemId.

tools.name: get-document
tools.description: One meeting document by ID. Also serves legislation documents, which carry organization_id: null and a bill_id.

tools.name: get-meeting
tools.description: Metadata and cloverleaf_url for one meeting ID.

tools.name: get-meeting-transcripts
tools.description: A meeting's transcript lines ordered by start_time, paginated (page, perPage 1 to 500, default 200). total_transcripts reports the full line count.

tools.name: get-signals-feed
tools.description: The authenticated user's Signals Feed: scored signals (insights at or above the user's score threshold, default 7) from their configured feed products and campaigns. Date range filters on signal creation and defaults to the last 30 days. perPage max 25. Returns facets for organizations, states, and campaigns.

tools.name: list-budget-books
tools.description: The budget books extracted for an organization, newest fiscal year first, with meeting_document_id, stage, year columns, and a current flag. The entry point for every other budget tool.

tools.name: list-budget-categories
tools.description: The budget category taxonomy for one budget book, with each category's parent and line count. Keys feed budget-rollup by category and the categories input of search-budget-line-items.

tools.name: list-budget-departments
tools.description: The departments in one budget book, each with its key and detail line count. Keys feed the department filter on budget-rollup and search-budget-line-items.

tools.name: list-contacts
tools.description: Civic contact roster by organization ID or by state, county, and city name (exact match). limit and offset pagination.

tools.name: list-organization-meetings
tools.description: Walk one jurisdiction's meetings newest first by published_at, with an optional case-insensitive title substring filter. No date filter; paginate.

tools.name: list-salesforce-account-mappings
tools.description: Salesforce account to Cloverleaf organization mappings for the authenticated user's organization. Paginated.

tools.name: list-territory-channels
tools.description: The authenticated user's territory channels (monitored organizations), filterable by name (q), stateId, and source (all, manual, auto).

tools.name: lookup-organization
tools.description: Resolve a jurisdiction name to a numeric organization ID by embedding similarity within a state or province. Returns id, name, meeting_count, and last_published_at per match, and a structured no-match result.

tools.name: run-document-keyword-search
tools.description: Lexical search over meeting documents. Filters: states, cities, counties, channelTypes, organizationIds, documentTypes. sortBy accepts hits or meeting_date, with direction. Default window is the last 7 days.

tools.name: run-legislation-keyword-search
tools.description: Lexical search over bill texts, amendments, and supplements. states is the only geography filter. Default window is the past 7 days through the next 365 days.

tools.name: run-meeting-keyword-search
tools.description: Lexical transcript search with anchor terms (mustIncludeTerms plus proximity). Filters: states, cities, counties, channelTypes, organizationIds. Each snippet carries its own cloverleaf_url. Default window is the last 7 days.

tools.name: run-purchase-keyword-search
tools.description: Lexical search over purchase records. Filters: states, departments, vendorNames, amount min and max, purchaseDatasetIds, countries, and integer id filters for organizations, cities, counties, and channelTypes. sortBy and direction. perPage default 10.

tools.name: save-signal-to-tasks
tools.description: Write tool. Saves a signal from get-signals-feed to the authenticated user's Tasks list in Cloverleaf. Idempotent per signal. Channel and territory analysis signals cannot be saved.

tools.name: search-budget-line-items
tools.description: Find budget line items about a topic in one budget book, by nearest budget categories plus printed label match. Requires organizationId and meetingDocumentId. limit max 50, skip for pagination.

tools.name: search-campaigns
tools.description: Saved search campaigns for the authenticated user, paginated, each with its search terms and filters. Read only. total_campaigns reports the full count.

tools.name: search-documents
tools.description: Semantic search over meeting documents with matching text chunks. Filters: states, cities, counties, channelTypes, organizationIds, documentTypes (agenda, minutes, packet, notice, budget). Default window is the last 7 days.

tools.name: search-insights
tools.description: The user's AI-generated insights, scored or not, newest first. No date filter. limit default 5, max 200, with page. Results are cut to a 2000-character preview unless includeFullResult is true. Pass userId for a teammate and states for territory.

tools.name: search-legislation
tools.description: Semantic search over state legislation documents. Returns bill_id when known. states is the only geography filter. Default window is the past 7 days through the next 365 days.

tools.name: search-meetings
tools.description: Semantic transcript search. Filters: states, cities, counties, channelTypes, organizationIds. Up to snippetsPerHit excerpts per meeting (default 5), each a 500-character preview with its own cloverleaf_url. Default window is the last 7 days.

tools.name: search-purchases
tools.description: Semantic search over purchase records. Same filters as run-purchase-keyword-search except sortBy and direction. perPage default 10. Default window is the last 7 days.

tools.name: search-verified-speakers
tools.description: People verified as meeting speakers by voice match. Returns first name, last name, organization, and title. query matches name or organization.

description_source: Condensed from the server's own tool descriptions and parameter schemas as returned by ToolSearch on 2026-11-13.
